command: set -euo pipefail; echo MACHINE=${LOCAL_BRIDGE_MACHINE_ID:-}; echo OWNER=${LOCAL_BRIDGE_OWNER:-}; systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p ExecStart -p FragmentPath -p DropInPaths -p ActiveState -p SubState -p MainPID; PID=$(systemctl --user show frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service -p MainPID --value); if [ "${PID:-0}" -gt 0 ]; then printf 'PROC_EXE='; readlink -f /proc/$PID/exe || true; printf 'PROC_CMD='; tr '\0' ' ' </proc/$PID/cmdline; echo; fi; for f in ~/.config/systemd/user/frankenstein-gespraechsmodus.service.d/*.conf; do [ -e "$f" ] || continue; echo ===$f===; cat "$f"; done
